players.product: Microchannel liquid cold plates, liquid-cooling modules and high-performance thermal interface materials (graphene pads, liquid metal) for AI servers, plus vapor chambers, heat pipes and air-cooling modules

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, roadshow meetings Aug 26-28 and Sep 1-3, 2026): revenue growth is driven by a steadily growing consumer-electronics base together with fast growth of new businesses such as data-center thermal management. Domestically the company will advance capacity at its Yixing, Dongguan and Beijing bases in step with customer demand and project progress; abroad, phase 1 of the Thailand base is in mass production and some major customers' Thailand factory audits and product introductions are complete, and capacity from phase 2 will be released according to demand, orders and project progress. Going forward it says it will focus on AI infrastructure, high-speed optical communication and consumer electronics, building out thermal materials, core thermal components, thermal modules and liquid-cooling solutions for leading customers.

players.product: VC (vapor chamber) thermal modules, thermal interface materials and liquid-cooling modules for 800G / 1.6T optical modules (connector liquid cold plates, NPO liquid cooling)

quarterly_data.signal: Innolight stake and synergy (IR record): management said the controlling shareholder / actual controller and concert parties signed the share transfer agreement with Innolight on August 13, 2026 for 31,372,504 tradable shares (10.47% of total share capital); after completion Innolight will hold 10.47% and control of the company does not change; procedures are in progress. Management said Innolight and the company sit upstream and downstream in the optical-communication chain with a synergy basis in advanced thermal management and functional materials, and that it will focus on 1.6T and next-generation high-speed optical modules and on NPO / CPO optical interconnect, offering complete optical-communication thermal solutions and pushing introduction of high-performance TIM, one-piece VC and liquid-cooling products. No supply contract or order is stated.

Jones Tech.why: Thermal-management maker whose optical-module VC thermal modules, server thermal parts, high-performance TIM and liquid-cooling modules (microchannel cold plates in volume use in data-center AI servers) grow with AI server and 800G / 1.6T optical-module build-out.
Jones Tech.evidence: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026): VC thermal module delivery for optical modules kept growing and its supplier position at core customers was consolidated; it entered a leading connector customer's supplier system with some thermal products in volume delivery and is developing connector liquid cold plates and NPO liquid cooling for 1.6T optical modules. Jones Tech investor Q&A (09-11-2026): some microchannel liquid-cooling products are in volume application in data-center AI servers.
